faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RDPR Thiruvarur Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the RDPR Thiruvarur Record Clerk position is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the department before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Record Clerk position, candidates must have passed the 10th standard examination from a recognized board or institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for the Record Clerk post is between 18 years and 37 years. Specific age relaxations are applicable for certain categories.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Record Clerk post in the Rural Development and Panchayat Department Thiruvarur for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Record Clerk position will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 15900 to Rs. 58500 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the RDPR Thiruvarur Record Clerk recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection stages for the Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Record Clerk post includes Application Scrutiny, a Test, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the RDPR Thiruvarur Record Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 50/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. Please refer to the official notification for payment details.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Rural Development and Panchayat Department Thiruvarur, which is https://tiruvarur.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the address to send the application form?
faq.answer: The specific address for sending the application form will be mentioned in the official notification PDF. Candidates are advised to carefully check the notification for the correct postal address.
